text: Blueprint must be fully mountable under a path prefix (p23q.org/shopping breaks)

Done in 3afa3ec (+5f72811 web_dist rebuild). base_url's path = mount root; API
default derives to <root>/api/v1 (explicit url_prefix wins); webapp/landing/apk
routes register under the root; index.html transformed once at registration
(asset URL rewrite + window.__APP_CONFIG__ with the router basename) and served
from memory with no-cache; web reads config lazily (appConfig.ts) for router
basename / API base / APK links. Domain root no longer hijacked — /login etc.
404 outside the prefix, host app keeps its root. Android needed NO change
(relative Retrofit paths already resolve against the entered URL). 163+ server
tests incl. new test_prefix_mount.py (10 cases); 44 web tests; wheel rebuilt
and verified to carry the new bundle.

For the reporter's deploy: keep the exact config already posted — with the new
wheel, base_url="https://p23q.org/shopping/" now yields the SPA at /shopping/,
API at /shopping/api/v1 (matching what the Android app already expects when
pointed at p23q.org/shopping), invites at /shopping/invite/<token>, APK at
/shopping/shoppinglist.apk. NOTE: any previously-minted invite links pointing at
domain-root /invite/... die with the move — re-send invites after redeploying.
